hypothesis: A completed, session-qualified market-structure shift with displacement followed by a retracement into its originating unmitigated imbalance or structural zone has positive expected-cost out-of-sample expectancy when risk is invalidated structurally and reward targets opposing confirmed liquidity.

dependencies.reason: The engine has rolling highs but no right-confirmed structural swing with an explicit known-at timestamp.
The engine has rolling lows but no right-confirmed structural swing with an explicit known-at timestamp.
The existing detector closes beyond a seven-candle rolling range; it does not break a confirmed swing or maintain prevailing structure state.
No detector establishes prior structure state and then detects a close beyond the opposing confirmed swing.
The existing detector identifies only the latest strict three-candle gap and has no configurable minimum size, origin association, or mitigation lifecycle.
The existing detector sweeps a rolling reference window, not a confirmed structural liquidity level.
The executable backtester supports fixed, percent, and ATR distances but cannot place a stop beyond the strategy's structural origin.
No detector selects the nearest valid opposing confirmed liquidity objective without future information.

long.structure: A bullish market-structure shift closes above the most recent confirmed opposing swing high.
long.displacement: The shift candle satisfies the frozen displacementDefinition.
long.retraceZone: Price trades into the unmitigated bullish fair-value gap created by or immediately following the shift.
long.trigger: The first completed M15 candle that rejects the zone and closes above its open.
long.session: Trigger and next-open entry must both be inside an allowed session.

short.structure: A bearish market-structure shift closes below the most recent confirmed opposing swing low.
short.displacement: The shift candle satisfies the frozen displacementDefinition.
short.retraceZone: Price trades into the unmitigated bearish fair-value gap created by or immediately following the shift.
short.trigger: The first completed M15 candle that rejects the zone and closes below its open.
short.session: Trigger and next-open entry must both be inside an allowed session.

stop.long: Below the minimum of the confirmed structural origin swing low and retracement-zone low, minus the ATR buffer.
stop.short: Above the maximum of the confirmed structural origin swing high and retracement-zone high, plus the ATR buffer.

target.primary: Nearest confirmed opposing liquidity target beyond entry that provides at least the configured minimum reward-to-risk.
target.selection: Nearest eligible price by absolute distance from entry.

invalidation.intrabar: The structural stop price is touched.
invalidation.close: A completed M15 candle closes beyond the structural origin in the adverse direction.
invalidation.entryCancellation: Cancel before entry if the structural origin is invalidated, the zone expires, or session eligibility ends.
